intro.title: From Heart to Heart
intro.body: In the midst of the harsh circumstances faced by our Sudanese refugee brothers and sisters in Egypt, this ministry was born as a response to the Christian call of love. We seek to be an outstretched hand, a voice of hope, and a safe spiritual and human space—where pain is transformed into hope, and need becomes an opportunity for a dignified life.
intro.verse: “I was a stranger and you invited me in.”

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To see Sudanese refugees spiritually and humanly empowered, living with dignity, connected to a loving faith community, and equipped to serve their families and communities—becoming living witnesses of God’s grace amid hardship.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To provide holistic care for Sudanese refugees in Egypt by integrating spiritual care, leadership development, child discipleship, and compassionate relief—through effective church partnerships and sustainable training programs.

items.support: To support Sudanese refugees spiritually, emotionally, and socially.
items.leaders: To equip pastors and leaders to shepherd churches and ministries within the refugee community.
items.children: To raise a generation of children rooted in faith and shaped by the values of love and peace.
items.needs: To meet essential needs that ease poverty and distress.
items.discipleship: To promote Christian discipleship as a way of life, especially among children.

why.title: Why This Ministry?
why.body: Because displacement is not merely a geographical transition—it is a deep human wound.
why.bodySecondary: And because the Church is called to be a home for the stranger, hope for the weary, and light in times of darkness.

together.title: Together, We Can Make a Difference
together.body: We welcome every partnership, every prayer, and every act of support— because ministry is not the work of individuals, but the journey of one body.
together.verse: “Let us do good to all people, especially to those who belong to the family of believers.”

pastors.title: Training Pastors and Ministry Leaders
pastors.intro: We believe that effective ministry begins with equipped leaders. Therefore, we provide:

points.one: Biblical and theological training programs for pastors and servants.
points.two: Workshops on pastoral leadership, trauma care, and crisis ministry.
points.three: Spiritual mentoring and accompaniment for leaders serving in refugee contexts.

sundaySchool.title: Training Sunday School Leaders in Evangelism and Discipleship
sundaySchool.intro: Because children are the future of the church and society:

points.one: We prepare Sunday School leaders with culturally and spiritually appropriate teaching materials.
points.two: We train them in interactive teaching methods and biblical storytelling.
points.three: We develop curricula focused on hope and inner healing for children.

children.title: Children’s Discipleship Programs
children.intro: Our goal is to build the child from the inside out:

points.one: Discipleship groups based on storytelling, play, and spiritual formation.
points.two: Nurturing Christian values: love, forgiveness, peace, and belonging.
points.three: Creative and recreational activities that support emotional and spiritual growth.

care.title: Compassionate and Pastoral Care
care.intro: Practical love that can be felt on the ground:

points.one: Providing food assistance and clothing for the most vulnerable families.
points.two: Supporting emergency cases (medical needs, rent, education).
points.three: Pastoral home visits to strengthen a sense of safety and belonging.
